import gc
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

ALL_CONT = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

COUNT_COLS = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
]

ALPHAS = [2.0, 20.0]
SEEDS = [0, 1]
N_SPLITS = 5
BATCH_SIZE = 2048
EPOCHS = 12
PATIENCE = 4

torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True


def encode_f27_codes(arr):
    raw = "".join(arr.astype(str).tolist()).encode("ascii")
    codes = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1, 10).astype(np.int64)
    return codes - 65


def build_substr_code(base, length, start):
    code = base[:, start].astype(np.int64) + 1
    for k in range(1, length):
        code = code * 27 + (base[:, start + k].astype(np.int64) + 1)
    return code


def engineer_static(df, codes0):
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    for c in ALL_CONT:
        out[c] = df[c].astype(np.float32)

    for c in COUNT_COLS:
        out[c] = df[c].astype(np.int32)

    out["f_29"] = df["f_29"].astype(np.int32)
    out["f_30"] = df["f_30"].astype(np.int32)

    codes = codes0 + 1

    for i in range(10):
        out[f"f27p{i}"] = codes[:, i]

    out["f27_sum"] = codes.sum(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    out["f27_mean"] = codes.mean(axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    out["f27_std"] = codes.std(axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    out["f27_min"] = codes.min(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    out["f27_max"] = codes.max(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    out["f27_range"] = out["f27_max"] - out["f27_min"]

    sorted_codes = np.sort(codes, axis=1)
    out["f27_uniq"] = (np.diff(sorted_codes, axis=1) != 0).sum(axis=1).astype(
        np.int8
    ) + 1

    out["f27_first_half"] = codes[:, :5].sum(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    out["f27_second_half"] = codes[:, 5:].sum(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    out["f27_half_diff"] = out["f27_first_half"] - out["f27_second_half"]

    for i in range(10):
        for j in range(i + 1, 10):
            out[f"f27eq_{i}_{j}"] = (codes[:, i] == codes[:, j]).astype(np.int8)

    for code in range(1, 27):
        out[f"cnt_{chr(64 + code)}"] = (codes == code).sum(axis=1).astype(np.int8)

    g1 = df[[f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(0, 7)]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
    g2 = df[[f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

    for prefix, g in [("g1", g1), ("g2", g2)]:
        out[f"{prefix}_mean"] = g.mean(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_std"] = g.std(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_min"] = g.min(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_max"] = g.max(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_range"] = g.max(axis=1) - g.min(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_sum"] = g.sum(axis=1)
        out[f"{prefix}_absmean"] = np.abs(g).mean(axis=1)

    out["g1_g2_diff"] = g1.mean(axis=1) - g2.mean(axis=1)
    out["g1_g2_prod"] = g1.mean(axis=1) * g2.mean(axis=1)
    out["g1_g2_ratio"] = ((g1.mean(axis=1) + 1e-6) / (g2.mean(axis=1) + 1e-6)).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    out["f28_abs"] = np.abs(df["f_28"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))

    cont = df[ALL_CONT].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
    for i in range(len(ALL_CONT)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(ALL_CONT)):
            out[f"prod_{ALL_CONT[i]}_{ALL_CONT[j]}"] = cont[:, i] * cont[:, j]
            out[f"diff_{ALL_CONT[i]}_{ALL_CONT[j]}"] = cont[:, i] - cont[:, j]

    f29 = df["f_29"].to_numpy()
    f30 = df["f_30"].to_numpy()
    f28 = df["f_28"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

    out["regime_combo"] = (f29 * 10 + f30).astype(np.int32)

    for r in [0, 1]:
        mask = (f29 == r).astype(np.float32)
        out[f"reg29_{r}_g1"] = g1.mean(axis=1) * mask
        out[f"reg29_{r}_g2"] = g2.mean(axis=1) * mask
        out[f"reg29_{r}_f28"] = f28 * mask

    for r in [0, 1, 2]:
        mask = (f30 == r).astype(np.float32)
        out[f"reg30_{r}_g1"] = g1.mean(axis=1) * mask
        out[f"reg30_{r}_g2"] = g2.mean(axis=1) * mask
        out[f"reg30_{r}_f28"] = f28 * mask

    return out


def make_cat_features(train, test, f27_codes0):
    cat_arrays = {}

    for c in COUNT_COLS:
        cat_arrays[c] = np.concatenate(
            [train[c].to_numpy(), test[c].to_numpy()]
        ).astype(np.int64)

    cat_arrays["f_29"] = np.concatenate(
        [train["f_29"].to_numpy(), test["f_29"].to_numpy()]
    ).astype(np.int64)
    cat_arrays["f_30"] = np.concatenate(
        [train["f_30"].to_numpy(), test["f_30"].to_numpy()]
    ).astype(np.int64)
    cat_arrays["regime_combo"] = cat_arrays["f_29"] * 10 + cat_arrays["f_30"]

    for l in range(1, 6):
        for start in range(0, 11 - l):
            name = f"f27_l{l}_s{start}"
            cat_arrays[name] = build_substr_code(f27_codes0, l, start)

    cat_arrays["f27_full"] = build_substr_code(f27_codes0, 10, 0)

    cat_names = list(cat_arrays.keys())
    cat_codes = {}

    for name, arr in cat_arrays.items():
        codes, _ = pd.factorize(arr)
        cat_codes[name] = codes.astype(np.int32)

    count_seq = np.column_stack([cat_arrays[c] for c in COUNT_COLS]).astype(np.int64)
    f29_all = cat_arrays["f_29"].astype(np.int64)
    f30_all = cat_arrays["f_30"].astype(np.int64)

    del cat_arrays
    gc.collect()

    return cat_names, cat_codes, count_seq, f29_all, f30_all


def build_te_features(tr_idx, va_idx, y, cat_names, cat_codes, n_train):
    n_tr = len(tr_idx)
    n_va = len(va_idx)
    n_te = cat_codes[cat_names[0]].shape[0] - n_train

    n_cols = len(cat_names) * (len(ALPHAS) + 1)
    te_tr = np.zeros((n_tr, n_cols), dtype=np.float32)
    te_va = np.zeros((n_va, n_cols), dtype=np.float32)
    te_test = np.zeros((n_te, n_cols), dtype=np.float32)

    y_tr_float = y[tr_idx].astype(np.float64)
    prior = y_tr_float.mean()

    for j, name in enumerate(cat_names):
        codes = cat_codes[name]
        max_code = int(codes.max()) + 1

        tr_codes = codes[tr_idx]
        va_codes = codes[va_idx]
        te_codes = codes[n_train:]

        sums = np.bincount(tr_codes, weights=y_tr_float, minlength=max_code)
        counts = np.bincount(tr_codes, minlength=max_code)

        tr_sum_loo = sums[tr_codes] - y_tr_float
        tr_cnt_loo = counts[tr_codes] - 1
        va_cnt = counts[va_codes]
        te_cnt = counts[te_codes]

        base = j * (len(ALPHAS) + 1)

        for k, alpha in enumerate(ALPHAS):
            te_tr[:, base + k] = (tr_sum_loo + alpha * prior) / (tr_cnt_loo + alpha)
            te_va[:, base + k] = (sums[va_codes] + alpha * prior) / (va_cnt + alpha)
            te_test[:, base + k] = (sums[te_codes] + alpha * prior) / (te_cnt + alpha)

        te_tr[:, base + len(ALPHAS)] = np.log1p(tr_cnt_loo)
        te_va[:, base + len(ALPHAS)] = np.log1p(va_cnt)
        te_test[:, base + len(ALPHAS)] = np.log1p(te_cnt)

    return te_tr, te_va, te_test


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, numeric_dim, char_vocab=26, count_vocab=32, count_len=12):
        super().__init__()

        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(char_vocab, 16)
        self.char_pos = nn.Embedding(10, 8)
        self.char_gru = nn.GRU(24, 64, bidirectional=True, batch_first=True)

        self.count_emb = nn.Embedding(count_vocab, 16)
        self.count_pos = nn.Embedding(count_len, 4)
        self.count_gru = nn.GRU(20, 64, bidirectional=True, batch_first=True)

        self.f29_emb = nn.Embedding(2, 4)
        self.f30_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 4)

        self.fc_in = nn.Linear(numeric_dim, 256)
        self.bn_in = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)

        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(256 + 256 + 256 + 8, 256)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)

        self.fc_out = nn.Linear(256, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.2)
        self.act = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, x_num, char_seq, count_seq, f29, f30):
        x = self.act(self.bn_in(self.fc_in(x_num)))
        x = self.drop(x)

        char_emb = self.char_emb(char_seq)
        pos_ids = torch.arange(char_seq.size(1), device=char_seq.device)
        pos_ids = pos_ids.unsqueeze(0).expand(char_seq.size(0), -1)
        char_emb = torch.cat([char_emb, self.char_pos(pos_ids)], dim=-1)

        char_out, _ = self.char_gru(char_emb)
        char_feat = torch.cat([char_out.mean(1), char_out.max(1).values], dim=1)

        count_emb = self.count_emb(count_seq)
        count_pos_ids = torch.arange(count_seq.size(1), device=count_seq.device)
        count_pos_ids = count_pos_ids.unsqueeze(0).expand(count_seq.size(0), -1)
        count_emb = torch.cat([count_emb, self.count_pos(count_pos_ids)], dim=-1)

        count_out, _ = self.count_gru(count_emb)
        count_feat = torch.cat([count_out.mean(1), count_out.max(1).values], dim=1)

        f29e = self.f29_emb(f29).squeeze(1)
        f30e = self.f30_emb(f30).squeeze(1)

        seq_feat = torch.cat([char_feat, count_feat, f29e, f30e], dim=1)
        x = torch.cat([x, seq_feat], dim=1)

        x = self.act(self.bn2(self.fc2(x)))
        x = self.drop(x)
        return self.fc_out(x).view(-1)


def predict_proba_loader(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    use_amp = device.type == "cuda"

    with torch.no_grad():
        for Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b, _ in loader:
            Xb = Xb.to(device)
            chb = chb.to(device)
            cntb = cntb.to(device)
            f29b = f29b.to(device)
            f30b = f30b.to(device)

            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b)
            else:
                logits = model(Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b)

            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy())

    return np.concatenate(preds)


def train_model(model, train_loader, valid_loader, y_va, device):
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS)
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=(device.type == "cuda"))
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

    best_auc = 0.0
    best_state = None
    no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        model.train()

        for Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b, yb in train_loader:
            Xb = Xb.to(device)
            chb = chb.to(device)
            cntb = cntb.to(device)
            f29b = f29b.to(device)
            f30b = f30b.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            if device.type == "cuda":
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b)
                    loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            else:
                logits = model(Xb, chb, cntb, f29b, f30b)
                loss = criterion(logits, yb)

            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()

        scheduler.step()

        va_pred = predict_proba_loader(model, valid_loader, device)
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, va_pred)

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1

        if no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    return best_auc


def clear_cache():
    gc.collect()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()


def main():
    print("Loading data...", flush=True)
    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    print("Encoding f_27 and engineering static features...", flush=True)
    f27_combined = np.concatenate(
        [train["f_27"].astype(str).to_numpy(), test["f_27"].astype(str).to_numpy()]
    )
    f27_codes0 = encode_f27_codes(f27_combined)

    static_train = engineer_static(train, f27_codes0[:n_train])
    static_test = engineer_static(test, f27_codes0[n_train:])

    static_cols = static_train.columns.tolist()
    static_raw_train = static_train.reset_index(drop=True)
    static_raw_test = static_test.reset_index(drop=True)

    print("Scaling static features...", flush=True)
    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(static_raw_train.to_numpy(np.float32))
    static_scaled_train = scaler.transform(
        static_raw_train.to_numpy(np.float32)
    ).astype(np.float32)
    static_scaled_test = scaler.transform(static_raw_test.to_numpy(np.float32)).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    print("Preparing target-encoding categories...", flush=True)
    cat_names, cat_codes, count_seq_all, f29_all, f30_all = make_cat_features(
        train, test, f27_codes0
    )
    char_seq_all = f27_codes0.astype(np.int64)

    te_cols = []
    for name in cat_names:
        for alpha in ALPHAS:
            te_cols.append(f"te_{name}_a{alpha}")
        te_cols.append(f"cnt_{name}")

    del train, test, f27_codes0
    clear_cache()

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Device: {device}", flush=True)

    # ---------- Neural network ----------
    print("Training neural network with target encodings...", flush=True)
    oof_nn = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float64)
    test_nn = np.zeros(n_test, dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"NN Fold {fold + 1}/{N_SPLITS}", flush=True)

        te_tr, te_va, te_test = build_te_features(
            tr_idx, va_idx, y, cat_names, cat_codes, n_train
        )

        Xtr_num = np.hstack([static_scaled_train[tr_idx], te_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        Xva_num = np.hstack([static_scaled_train[va_idx], te_va]).astype(np.float32)
        Xte_num = np.hstack([static_scaled_test, te_test]).astype(np.float32)

        train_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            torch.from_numpy(Xtr_num),
            torch.from_numpy(char_seq_all[tr_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(count_seq_all[tr_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(f29_all[tr_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(f30_all[tr_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(y[tr_idx].astype(np.float32)),
        )
        valid_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            torch.from_numpy(Xva_num),
            torch.from_numpy(char_seq_all[va_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(count_seq_all[va_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(f29_all[va_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(f30_all[va_idx]),
            torch.from_numpy(y[va_idx].astype(np.float32)),
        )
        test_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            torch.from_numpy(Xte_num),
            torch.from_numpy(char_seq_all[n_train:]),
            torch.from_numpy(count_seq_all[n_train:]),
            torch.from_numpy(f29_all[n_train:]),
            torch.from_numpy(f30_all[n_train:]),
            torch.zeros(n_test, dtype=torch.float32),
        )

        train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
            train_ds,
            batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
            shuffle=True,
            pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda"),
        )
        valid_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
            valid_ds, batch_size=4096, shuffle=False, pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda")
        )
        test_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
            test_ds, batch_size=4096, shuffle=False, pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda")
        )

        fold_va_pred = np.zeros(len(va_idx), dtype=np.float64)
        fold_te_pred = np.zeros(n_test, dtype=np.float64)

        for seed_idx, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
            torch.manual_seed(1000 + fold * 10 + seed)
            np.random.seed(1000 + fold * 10 + seed)

            model = Net(Xtr_num.shape[1]).to(device)
            auc = train_model(model, train_loader, valid_loader, y[va_idx], device)

            va_pred = predict_proba_loader(model, valid_loader, device)
            te_pred = predict_proba_loader(model, test_loader, device)

            fold_va_pred += va_pred / len(SEEDS)
            fold_te_pred += te_pred / len(SEEDS)

            print(f"  seed {seed_idx + 1}/{len(SEEDS)} AUC: {auc:.6f}", flush=True)

            del model
            clear_cache()

        oof_nn[va_idx] = fold_va_pred
        test_nn += fold_te_pred / N_SPLITS

        print(
            f"NN Fold {fold + 1} seeded-average OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y[va_idx], fold_va_pred):.6f}",
            flush=True,
        )

        del Xtr_num, Xva_num, Xte_num, te_tr, te_va, te_test
        del train_ds, valid_ds, test_ds, train_loader, valid_loader, test_loader
        clear_cache()

    nn_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_nn)
    print(f"NN OOF AUC: {nn_auc:.6f}", flush=True)

    sub_nn = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": np.clip(test_nn, 0, 1)})
    sub_nn.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved interim NN submission.csv", flush=True)

    # Free NN-only memory before LightGBM.
    del static_scaled_train, static_scaled_test, char_seq_all, count_seq_all
    del f29_all, f30_all, cat_codes
    clear_cache()

    # ---------- LightGBM ----------
    print("Training LightGBM on interaction features...", flush=True)
    oof_lgb = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float64)
    test_lgb = np.zeros(n_test, dtype=np.float64)

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 64,
        "min_child_samples": 500,
        "feature_fraction": 0.5,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l1": 0.0,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "max_bin": 255,
        "n_jobs": 8,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
    }

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"LGB Fold {fold + 1}/{N_SPLITS}", flush=True)

        X_tr = static_raw_train.iloc[tr_idx]
        X_va = static_raw_train.iloc[va_idx]
        X_te = static_raw_test

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y[tr_idx])
        dva = lgb.Dataset(X_va, label=y[va_idx], reference=dtr)

        bst = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )

        fold_pred = bst.predict(X_va, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration)
        oof_lgb[va_idx] = fold_pred
        test_lgb += bst.predict(X_te, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration) / N_SPLITS

        print(
            f"LGB Fold {fold + 1} OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y[va_idx], fold_pred):.6f}",
            flush=True,
        )

        del bst, dtr, dva, X_tr, X_va, X_te
        clear_cache()

    lgb_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_lgb)
    print(f"LGB OOF AUC: {lgb_auc:.6f}", flush=True)

    # ---------- Stacking ----------
    print("Stacking OOF predictions...", flush=True)
    oof_mat = np.column_stack([oof_nn, oof_lgb])
    test_mat = np.column_stack([test_nn, test_lgb])

    inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    stack_oof = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float64)

    for tr, va in inner_skf.split(oof_mat, y):
        lr = LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=1000)
        lr.fit(oof_mat[tr], y[tr])
        stack_oof[va] = lr.predict_proba(oof_mat[va])[:, 1]

    stack_auc = roc_auc_score(y, stack_oof)
    simple_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_mat.mean(axis=1))

    print(f"NN OOF AUC: {nn_auc:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"LGB OOF AUC: {lgb_auc:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Simple average OOF AUC: {simple_auc:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"LR-stack OOF AUC: {stack_auc:.6f}", flush=True)

    if stack_auc >= simple_auc:
        lr_final = LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=1000)
        lr_final.fit(oof_mat, y)
        final_pred = lr_final.predict_proba(test_mat)[:, 1]
        final_auc = stack_auc
        print("Using LR-stack for final predictions.", flush=True)
    else:
        final_pred = test_mat.mean(axis=1)
        final_auc = simple_auc
        print("Using simple average for final predictions.", flush=True)

    final_pred = np.clip(final_pred, 0.0, 1.0)
    print(f"FINAL 5-FOLD CV AUC: {final_auc:.6f}", flush=True)

    sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": final_pred})
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved final submission.csv", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def te_loo(keys_tr, y_tr, keys_va, keys_te, prior, smoothing=SMOOTHING):

    cnt = grp.transform("count").to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

    train_enc = ((s - y_tr + prior * smoothing) / (cnt - 1.0 + smoothing)).astype(

    )

    enc_map = ((agg["sum"] + prior * smoothing) / (agg["count"] + smoothing)).to_dict()

    return {
        "cont_tr": cont_tr,
        "cont_va": cont_va,
        "cont_te": cont_te,
        "char_tr": X_char_all[tr_idx],
        "char_va": X_char_all[va_idx],
        "char_te": X_char_all[n_train:],
        "count_tr": X_count_all[tr_idx],
        "count_va": X_count_all[va_idx],
        "count_te": X_count_all[n_train:],
        "reg1_tr": X_reg1_all[tr_idx],
        "reg1_va": X_reg1_all[va_idx],
        "reg1_te": X_reg1_all[n_train:],
        "reg2_tr": X_reg2_all[tr_idx],
        "reg2_va": X_reg2_all[va_idx],
        "reg2_te": X_reg2_all[n_train:],
        "te_tr": te_tr,
        "te_va": te_va,
        "te_te": te_te,
        "y_tr": y[tr_idx],
        "y_va": y[va_idx],
    }


class SequenceTabularNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, char_vocab, count_vocab, n_cont, n_te, emb_dim=EMB_DIM):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(char_vocab, 32)
        self.count_emb = nn.Embedding(count_vocab, 16)
        self.reg1_emb = nn.Embedding(2, 4)
        self.reg2_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 4)

        self.char_gru = nn.GRU(32, GRU_HIDDEN, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.count_gru = nn.GRU(16, GRU_HIDDEN, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        rnn_out = GRU_HIDDEN * 2
        in_dim = rnn_out * 2 + 4 + 4 + n_cont + n_te

        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_dim, 256)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(256, emb_dim)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(emb_dim)
        self.out = nn.Linear(emb_dim, 1)

    def forward(self, cont, char_seq, count_seq, reg1, reg2, te):
        char_emb = self.char_emb(char_seq)
        count_emb = self.count_emb(count_seq)

        char_out, _ = self.char_gru(char_emb)
        count_out, _ = self.count_gru(count_emb)

        char_feat = char_out.mean(dim=1)
        count_feat = count_out.mean(dim=1)

        reg1 = self.reg1_emb(reg1)
        reg2 = self.reg2_emb(reg2)

        x = torch.cat([char_feat, count_feat, reg1, reg2, cont, te], dim=1)
        x = F.relu(self.bn1(self.fc1(x)))
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.3, training=self.training)
        x = F.relu(self.bn2(self.fc2(x)))
        emb = x
        x = F.dropout(x, p=0.2, training=self.training)
        logits = self.out(x).squeeze(1)
        return logits, emb


def predict_nn_emb(model, cont, char_seq, count_seq, reg1, reg2, te, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    embs = []
    n = len(cont)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, n, PRED_BATCH):
            c = torch.from_numpy(cont[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)
            ch = torch.from_numpy(char_seq[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)
            co = torch.from_numpy(count_seq[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)
            r1 = torch.from_numpy(reg1[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)
            r2 = torch.from_numpy(reg2[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)
            teb = torch.from_numpy(te[i : i + PRED_BATCH]).to(device)

            logits, emb = model(c, ch, co, r1, r2, teb)
            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logits).float().cpu().numpy())
            embs.append(emb.float().cpu().numpy())

    return np.concatenate(preds), np.concatenate(embs)


def train_nn_fold(fd, seed, device):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    model = SequenceTabularNN(char_vocab, count_vocab, N_CONT, N_TE).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=MAX_EPOCHS)
    use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler() if use_amp else None

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(fd["cont_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["char_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["count_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["reg1_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["reg2_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["te_tr"]),
        torch.from_numpy(fd["y_tr"]),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, drop_last=True)

    best_auc = -1.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(MAX_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for cb, chb, cob, r1b, r2b, teb, yb in loader:
            cb = cb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            chb = chb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            cob = cob.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            r1b = r1b.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            r2b = r2b.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            teb = teb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits, _ = model(cb, chb, cob, r1b, r2b, teb)
                    loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                logits, _ = model(cb, chb, cob, r1b, r2b, teb)
                loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()

        val_pred, _ = predict_nn_emb(
            model,
            fd["cont_va"],
            fd["char_va"],
            fd["count_va"],
            fd["reg1_va"],
            fd["reg2_va"],
            fd["te_va"],
            device,
        )
        auc = roc_auc_score(fd["y_va"], val_pred)
        print(f"      seed {seed} epoch {epoch + 1}: AUC {auc:.6f}", flush=True)

        if auc > best_auc + 1e-6:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            patience = 0
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= PATIENCE:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    val_pred, val_emb = predict_nn_emb(
        model,
        fd["cont_va"],
        fd["char_va"],
        fd["count_va"],
        fd["reg1_va"],
        fd["reg2_va"],
        fd["te_va"],
        device,
    )
    te_pred, te_emb = predict_nn_emb(
        model,
        fd["cont_te"],
        fd["char_te"],
        fd["count_te"],
        fd["reg1_te"],
        fd["reg2_te"],
        fd["te_te"],
        device,
    )
    return val_pred, val_emb, te_pred, te_emb, best_auc

class TabularTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        n_cont,
        n_cat_features,
        cat_vocab,
        d_model=D_MODEL,
        nhead=8,
        num_layers=NUM_LAYERS,
        dropout=DROPOUT,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.cont_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n_cont, d_model) * 0.02)
        self.cont_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n_cont, d_model))
        self.cont_tokens = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n_cont, d_model))
        nn.init.normal_(self.cont_tokens, std=0.02)

        self.cat_embedding = nn.Embedding(cat_vocab, d_model)
        self.cat_tokens = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n_cat_features, d_model))
        nn.init.normal_(self.cat_tokens, std=0.02)

        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, d_model))
        nn.init.normal_(self.cls_token, std=0.02)

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=d_model * 4,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
            nn.Linear(d_model, d_model),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(d_model, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, cont, cat):
        # Continuous token embeddings: scalar -> d_model
        cont_emb = self.cont_weights[None, :, :] * cont[:, :, None]
        cont_emb = cont_emb + self.cont_bias[None, :, :]
        cont_emb = cont_emb + self.cont_tokens[None, :, :]

        # Categorical token embeddings
        cat_emb = self.cat_embedding(cat) + self.cat_tokens[None, :, :]

        x = torch.cat([cont_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)
        B = x.size(0)
        cls = self.cls_token.expand(B, -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls, x], dim=1)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.encoder(x)
        return self.head(x[:, 0]).squeeze(1)


def target_encode_fold(keys_all, max_id, tr_idx, y_tr, va_idx, te_idx, alpha=TE_ALPHA):
    keys_tr = keys_all[tr_idx].astype(np.int64)
    sums = np.bincount(
        keys_tr, weights=y_tr.astype(np.float64), minlength=max_id
    ).astype(np.float64)
    counts = np.bincount(keys_tr, minlength=max_id).astype(np.float64)

    prior = float(y_tr.mean())
    prior_alpha = prior * alpha

    enc_tr = (sums[keys_tr] - y_tr.astype(np.float64) + prior_alpha) / (
        counts[keys_tr] - 1.0 + alpha
    )

    keys_va = keys_all[va_idx].astype(np.int64)
    enc_va = (sums[keys_va] + prior_alpha) / (counts[keys_va] + alpha)

    keys_te = keys_all[te_idx].astype(np.int64)
    enc_te = (sums[keys_te] + prior_alpha) / (counts[keys_te] + alpha)

    return (
        enc_tr.astype(np.float32),
        enc_va.astype(np.float32),
        enc_te.astype(np.float32),
    )


def update_ema(ema_model, model, decay=EMB_DECAY):
    with torch.no_grad():
        for ema_p, p in zip(ema_model.parameters(), model.parameters()):
            ema_p.mul_(decay).add_(p.detach(), alpha=1.0 - decay)


@torch.no_grad()
def predict(model, cont, cat, batch_size=PRED_BATCH):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    for i in range(0, cont.shape[0], batch_size):
        xb = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(cont[i : i + batch_size])).to(device)
        cb = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(cat[i : i + batch_size])).to(device)
        with autocast(enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(xb, cb)
        preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds).astype(np.float32)


def fit_fold(
    cont_tr,
    cat_tr,
    y_tr,
    cont_va,
    cat_va,
    y_va,
    cont_te,
    cat_te,
    n_cont,
    n_cat_features,
    cat_vocab,
    fold,
    seed,
):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    model = TabularTransformer(n_cont, n_cat_features, cat_vocab).to(device)
    ema_model = copy.deepcopy(model)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS)
    scaler = GradScaler(enabled=use_amp)

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(cont_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(cat_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(y_tr),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, drop_last=True, num_workers=0
    )

    best_auc = -1.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        t0 = time.time()

        for xb, cb, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            cb = cb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast(enabled=use_amp):
                logits = model(xb, cb)
                loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits.float(), yb)

            if use_amp:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
                optimizer.step()

            update_ema(ema_model, model, EMB_DECAY)

        scheduler.step()

        val_pred = predict(ema_model, cont_va, cat_va)
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, val_pred)
        print(
            f"  Fold {fold} epoch {epoch} AUC: {auc:.6f} ({time.time() - t0:.1f}s)",
            flush=True,
        )

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(ema_model.state_dict())
            patience = 0
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= PATIENCE:
                break

    ema_model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    val_pred = predict(ema_model, cont_va, cat_va)
    test_pred = predict(ema_model, cont_te, cat_te)
    return val_pred, test_pred, best_auc

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

SEED = 42

n_test = len(test)
test_ids = test["id"].values

cont_cols = (
    [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7)] + [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)] + ["f_28"]
)
count_cols = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)]

all_df = pd.concat(
    [train.drop(columns=["target", "id"]), test.drop(columns=["id"])],

# Encode f_27 as 10 character codes.
raw = all_df["f_27"].astype(str).values
joined = "".join(raw)
char_bytes = np.frombuffer(joined.encode("utf-8"), dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1, 10)
char_codes = np.where(
    (char_bytes >= 65) & (char_bytes <= 90), char_bytes - 65, 26
).astype(np.int64)

f27_id = pd.factorize(all_df["f_27"].values)[0].astype(np.int64)
count_values = all_df[count_cols].values.astype(np.int64)

f29 = all_df["f_29"].values.astype(np.int64)
f30 = all_df["f_30"].values.astype(np.int64)
regime_combo = f29 * 3 + f30


def build_numeric_base(X):
    G1 = X[:, :7]
    G2 = X[:, 7:15]
    f28 = X[:, 15:16]

    parts = [G1, G2, f28]

    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(i + 1, 7):
            parts.append((G1[:, i] * G1[:, j])[:, None])
            parts.append((G1[:, i] - G1[:, j])[:, None])

    for i in range(8):
        for j in range(i + 1, 8):
            parts.append((G2[:, i] * G2[:, j])[:, None])
            parts.append((G2[:, i] - G2[:, j])[:, None])

    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(8):
            parts.append((G1[:, i] * G2[:, j])[:, None])
            parts.append((G1[:, i] - G2[:, j])[:, None])

    for i in range(7):
        parts.append((f28[:, 0] * G1[:, i])[:, None])
        parts.append((f28[:, 0] - G1[:, i])[:, None])

    for j in range(8):
        parts.append((f28[:, 0] * G2[:, j])[:, None])
        parts.append((f28[:, 0] - G2[:, j])[:, None])

    parts.append(G1.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(G1.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(G1.std(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(G2.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(G2.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(G2.std(axis=1, keepdims=True))

    return np.concatenate(parts, axis=1).astype(np.float32)


Xcont = all_df[cont_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_num_base = build_numeric_base(Xcont)
X_num_base = np.hstack(
    [
        X_num_base,
        count_values.astype(np.float32),
        f29.astype(np.float32).reshape(-1, 1),
        f30.astype(np.float32).reshape(-1, 1),
    ]
)

# Target encoding group keys.
group_keys = [
    f29,

]
for i in range(10):

for i in range(12):
    group_keys.append(count_values[:, i])
for i in range(9):
    group_keys.append((char_codes[:, i] * 27 + char_codes[:, i + 1]).astype(np.int64))

del all_df, train, test, Xcont, raw, joined, char_bytes
gc.collect()

test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)


def target_encode_numeric(key_all, y_all, train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, m=20.0):
    key_all = np.ascontiguousarray(key_all)
    max_id = int(key_all.max()) + 1
    y_train = y_all[train_idx].astype(np.float64)

    grp_sum = np.bincount(key_all[train_idx], weights=y_train, minlength=max_id)
    grp_cnt = np.bincount(key_all[train_idx], minlength=max_id)

    global_mean = y_train.mean()

    tr_sum = grp_sum[key_all[train_idx]]
    tr_cnt = grp_cnt[key_all[train_idx]]
    tr_te = (tr_sum - y_train + global_mean * m) / (tr_cnt - 1.0 + m)

    va_te = (grp_sum[key_all[val_idx]] + global_mean * m) / (
        grp_cnt[key_all[val_idx]] + m
    )
    te_te = (grp_sum[key_all[test_idx]] + global_mean * m) / (
        grp_cnt[key_all[test_idx]] + m
    )

    return tr_te.astype(np.float32), va_te.astype(np.float32), te_te.astype(np.float32)


def compute_te_fold(group_keys, y, train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, m=20.0):
    tr_feats, va_feats, te_feats = [], [], []
    for key in group_keys:
        tr, va, te = target_encode_numeric(key, y, train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, m)
        tr_feats.append(tr)
        va_feats.append(va)
        te_feats.append(te)
    return (
        np.column_stack(tr_feats),
        np.column_stack(va_feats),
        np.column_stack(te_feats),
    )


def masked_ce(logits, targets, mask):
    logits = logits.reshape(-1, logits.size(-1))
    targets = targets.reshape(-1)
    loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction="none")
    loss = loss.view(mask.size(0), mask.size(1))
    mask_float = mask.float()
    denom = mask_float.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
    return (loss * mask_float).sum() / denom


class SeqAuxModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_numeric,
        num_char_vocab,
        num_count_vocab,
        d_model=128,
        gru_hidden=64,
        num_layers=2,
        dropout=0.15,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_model = d_model
        seq_len = 23  # CLS + 10 chars + 12 counts

        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(num_char_vocab, d_model)
        self.count_emb = nn.Embedding(num_count_vocab, d_model)
        self.char_mask_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(d_model))
        self.count_mask_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(d_model))
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(d_model))

        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(seq_len, d_model)
        self.type_emb = nn.Embedding(3, d_model)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

        self.gru = nn.GRU(
            d_model,
            gru_hidden,
            num_layers=num_layers,
            batch_first=True,
            bidirectional=True,
            dropout=dropout if num_layers > 1 else 0.0,
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(2 * gru_hidden)

        self.num_fc = nn.Linear(num_numeric, d_model)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d_model + 2 * gru_hidden + d_model, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )

        self.char_head = nn.Linear(2 * gru_hidden, num_char_vocab)
        self.count_head = nn.Linear(2 * gru_hidden, num_count_vocab)

        self.register_buffer("pos_ids", torch.arange(seq_len, dtype=torch.long))
        self.register_buffer(
            "type_ids",
            torch.cat(
                [
                    torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long),
                    torch.ones(10, dtype=torch.long),
                    torch.full((12,), 2, dtype=torch.long),
                ]
            ),
        )

        nn.init.normal_(self.char_mask_emb, std=0.02)
        nn.init.normal_(self.count_mask_emb, std=0.02)
        nn.init.normal_(self.cls_token, std=0.02)

    def forward(self, char_ids, count_ids, num_feat, char_mask=None, count_mask=None):
        B = char_ids.size(0)

        char_tok = self.char_emb(char_ids)
        count_tok = self.count_emb(count_ids)

        if char_mask is not None:
            mask = char_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
            char_tok = (
                char_tok * (1.0 - mask) + self.char_mask_emb.view(1, 1, -1) * mask
            )

        if count_mask is not None:
            mask = count_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
            count_tok = (
                count_tok * (1.0 - mask) + self.count_mask_emb.view(1, 1, -1) * mask
            )

        cls_tok = self.cls_token.view(1, 1, -1).expand(B, -1, -1)
        seq = torch.cat([cls_tok, char_tok, count_tok], dim=1)

        pos = self.pos_emb(self.pos_ids).unsqueeze(0)
        typ = self.type_emb(self.type_ids).unsqueeze(0)
        seq = seq + pos + typ
        seq = self.dropout(seq)

        out, _ = self.gru(seq)
        out = self.norm(out)

        cls = out[:, 0]
        pooled = torch.cat([cls, out[:, 1:].mean(dim=1)], dim=1)

        num_h = F.relu(self.num_fc(num_feat))
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, num_h], dim=1)
        logit = self.head(combined).squeeze(1)

        char_logits = self.char_head(out[:, 1:11])
        count_logits = self.count_head(out[:, 11:23])

        return logit, char_logits, count_logits


def predict(model, char, count, num, device, batch_size=4096):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(char), batch_size):
            cb = torch.from_numpy(char[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            kb = torch.from_numpy(count[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            nb = torch.from_numpy(num[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            logit, _, _ = model(cb, kb, nb)
            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logit).cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds)


def train_fold(
    fold,
    train_idx,
    val_idx,
    X_num_base,
    char_codes,
    count_values,
    y,
    group_keys,
    test_idx,
    device,
):
    te_tr, te_va, te_te = compute_te_fold(group_keys, y, train_idx, val_idx, test_idx)

    base_tr = X_num_base[train_idx]
    base_va = X_num_base[val_idx]
    base_te = X_num_base[test_idx]

    scaler_b = StandardScaler().fit(base_tr)
    scaler_t = StandardScaler().fit(te_tr)

    num_tr = np.hstack([scaler_b.transform(base_tr), scaler_t.transform(te_tr)]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    num_va = np.hstack([scaler_b.transform(base_va), scaler_t.transform(te_va)]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    num_te = np.hstack([scaler_b.transform(base_te), scaler_t.transform(te_te)]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    char_tr = char_codes[train_idx]
    count_tr = count_values[train_idx]
    char_va = char_codes[val_idx]
    count_va = count_values[val_idx]
    char_te = char_codes[test_idx]
    count_te = count_values[test_idx]

    y_tr = y[train_idx].astype(np.float32)

    torch.manual_seed(SEED + fold)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED + fold)

    model = SeqAuxModel(
        num_numeric=num_tr.shape[1],
        num_char_vocab=28,
        num_count_vocab=int(count_values.max()) + 2,
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    epochs = 8
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=epochs)

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(char_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(count_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(num_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(y_tr),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset, batch_size=2048, shuffle=True, drop_last=True, pin_memory=True
    )

    best_auc = -1.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 0
    mask_prob = 0.12
    aux_weight = 0.2

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for cb, kb, nb, yb in loader:
            cb = cb.to(device)
            kb = kb.to(device)
            nb = nb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            char_mask = torch.rand(cb.size(0), cb.size(1), device=device) < mask_prob
            count_mask = torch.rand(kb.size(0), kb.size(1), device=device) < mask_prob

            logit, char_logits, count_logits = model(
                cb,
                kb,
                nb,
                char_mask=char_mask,
                count_mask=count_mask,
            )

            loss_bce = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logit, yb)
            loss_char = masked_ce(char_logits, cb, char_mask)
            loss_count = masked_ce(count_logits, kb, count_mask)
            loss = loss_bce + aux_weight * (loss_char + loss_count)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()

]

    np.frombuffer("".join(raw27).encode("utf-8"), dtype=np.uint8).reshape(N, 10).copy()
)
upper_mask = (seq_chars >= 65) & (seq_chars <= 90)
char_codes = np.where(upper_mask, seq_chars.astype(np.int64) - 65, 26)
del seq_chars, upper_mask

# ---- count / regime arrays for the neural model ----
cnt_values = X_raw[COUNT_COLS].values.astype(np.int64)
cnt_values = np.clip(cnt_values, 0, 16)
f29 = X_raw["f_29"].values.astype(np.int64)
f30 = X_raw["f_30"].values.astype(np.int64)

# ---- dense tabular interaction features ----
n_cont = len(CONT_COLS)
n_feat = n_cont + 2 * (n_cont * (n_cont - 1) // 2) + 5 + 26 + 2 + 45

idx += n_cont

        idx += 1
        X_num[:, idx] = cont[:, i] - cont[:, j]
        idx += 1

cnt_float = cnt_values.astype(np.float32)
X_num[:, idx] = cnt_float.sum(axis=1)
idx += 1
X_num[:, idx] = cnt_float.mean(axis=1)
idx += 1
X_num[:, idx] = cnt_float.std(axis=1)
idx += 1
X_num[:, idx] = cnt_float.max(axis=1)
idx += 1
X_num[:, idx] = cnt_float.min(axis=1)
idx += 1

char_freq = np.zeros((N, 26), dtype=np.float32)
for v in range(26):
    char_freq[:, v] = (char_codes == v).sum(axis=1)
X_num[:, idx : idx + 26] = char_freq / 10.0
idx += 26

sorted_codes = np.sort(char_codes, axis=1)
X_num[:, idx] = (np.diff(sorted_codes, axis=1) != 0).sum(axis=1).astype(
    np.float32
) + 1.0
idx += 1
X_num[:, idx] = char_freq.max(axis=1)
idx += 1

for i in range(10):

        idx += 1

assert idx == n_feat, idx

# ---- fold-local target encoding definitions ----
te_vals = []

# count columns
for col in COUNT_COLS:
    te_vals.append(X_raw[col].values.astype(np.int64))

# character positions
for i in range(10):
    te_vals.append(char_codes[:, i])

# n-grams up to length 4
ser27 = pd.Series(raw27)
for k in (2, 3, 4):

        te_vals.append(ser27.str.slice(i, i + k).values)

te_vals.append(X_raw["f_30"].values.astype(np.int64))

del ser27


# ---- leak-free leave-one-out smoothed target encoding ----
def compute_te_maps(train_vals, val_vals, test_vals, y_train):
    prior = float(y_train.mean())
    m = 20.0

    codes, inv = np.unique(train_vals, return_inverse=True)
    sums = np.bincount(inv, weights=y_train, minlength=len(codes)).astype(np.float64)
    cnts = np.bincount(inv, minlength=len(codes)).astype(np.float64)

    te_agg = (sums + prior * m) / (cnts + m)

    # LOO target encoding for the training part
    train_te = ((sums[inv] - y_train + prior * m) / (cnts[inv] - 1.0 + m)).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    def map_values(vals):
        pos = np.searchsorted(codes, vals)
        out = np.full(len(vals), prior, dtype=np.float32)
        mask = pos < len(codes)
        if mask.any():
            exact = codes[pos[mask]] == vals[mask]
            idxs = np.where(mask)[0][exact]
            out[idxs] = te_agg[pos[mask][exact]]
        return out

    return train_te, map_values(val_vals), map_values(test_vals)


# ---- model ----
class InteractionNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, num_te, d_model=128, nhead=8, n_layers=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(27, 32)
        self.count_emb = nn.Embedding(17, 32)
        self.char_proj = nn.Linear(32, d_model)
        self.count_proj = nn.Linear(32, d_model)

        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, d_model))
        self.pos_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 23, d_model))
        self.token_type = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(3, d_model))

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=256,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=n_layers)

        self.bn_num = nn.BatchNorm1d(num_numeric)
        self.num_fc = nn.Linear(num_numeric, 256)
        self.te_fc = nn.Linear(num_te, 64)

        self.f29_emb = nn.Embedding(2, 4)
        self.f30_emb = nn.Embedding(3, 4)

        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d_model + 256 + 64 + 8, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(128, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_f29, x_f30, x_te):
        B = x_char.size(0)

        char_e = self.char_proj(self.char_emb(x_char))
        cnt_e = self.count_proj(self.count_emb(x_cnt))
        cls = self.cls_token.expand(B, -1, -1)

        tokens = torch.cat([cls, char_e, cnt_e], dim=1)

        cls_type = self.token_type[0].unsqueeze(0).expand(B, 1, -1)
        char_type = self.token_type[1].unsqueeze(0).expand(B, 10, -1)
        cnt_type = self.token_type[2].unsqueeze(0).expand(B, 12, -1)
        tok_types = torch.cat([cls_type, char_type, cnt_type], dim=1)

        tokens = tokens + self.pos_emb + tok_types
        tokens = self.transformer(tokens)
        seq = tokens[:, 0, :]

        num = F.relu(self.num_fc(self.bn_num(x_num)))
        te = F.relu(self.te_fc(x_te))
        reg = torch.cat([self.f29_emb(x_f29), self.f30_emb(x_f30)], dim=1)

        z = torch.cat([seq, num, te, reg], dim=1)
        return self.mlp(z).squeeze(1)


def predict(model, X_num, X_char, X_cnt, X_f29, X_f30, X_te, device, batch_size=2048):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for start in range(0, len(X_num), batch_size):
            xb = torch.from_numpy(X_num[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)
            xc = torch.from_numpy(X_char[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)
            xcnt = torch.from_numpy(X_cnt[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)
            x29 = torch.from_numpy(X_f29[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)
            x30 = torch.from_numpy(X_f30[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)
            xte = torch.from_numpy(X_te[start : start + batch_size]).to(device)

            with autocast(enabled=torch.cuda.is_available()):
                logits = model(xb, xc, xcnt, x29, x30, xte)

            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds)

    )

        dataset,

        drop_last=True,

def target_encode_code(code_col, y_all, tr_idx, va_idx, te_idx, smooth=SMOOTH):
    code_tr = code_col[tr_idx]
    max_code = int(code_col.max()) + 1

    sum_cnt = np.bincount(code_tr, weights=y_all[tr_idx], minlength=max_code).astype(
        np.float64
    )
    cnts = np.bincount(code_tr, minlength=max_code).astype(np.float64)
    prior = float(y_all[tr_idx].mean())

    enc_cat = (sum_cnt + prior * smooth) / (cnts + smooth)

    tr_cnt = cnts[code_tr]
    tr_sum = sum_cnt[code_tr]
    tr_y = y_all[tr_idx]
    tr_enc = np.where(
        tr_cnt > 1.0,
        (tr_sum - tr_y + prior * smooth) / (tr_cnt - 1.0 + smooth),
        prior,
    ).astype(np.float32)

    va_enc = enc_cat[code_col[va_idx]].astype(np.float32)
    te_enc = enc_cat[code_col[te_idx]].astype(np.float32)
    return tr_enc, va_enc, te_enc


class TabularNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_numeric,
        char_vocab,
        bigram_vocab,
        count_vocab,
        regime_vocabs=(2, 3, 6),
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.dropout = 0.2

        self.bn_in = nn.BatchNorm1d(num_numeric)
        self.fc_num = nn.Linear(num_numeric, 256)
        self.bn_num = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)
        self.fc_num2 = nn.Linear(256, 128)

        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(char_vocab, 32)
        self.char_gru = nn.GRU(32, 64, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)

        self.bigram_emb = nn.Embedding(bigram_vocab, 32)
        self.bigram_gru = nn.GRU(32, 64, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)

        self.count_seq_emb = nn.Embedding(count_vocab, 16)
        self.count_seq_gru = nn.GRU(16, 64, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)

        self.count_col_embs = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(count_vocab, 8) for _ in range(12)]
        )

        self.reg29_emb = nn.Embedding(regime_vocabs[0], 4)
        self.reg30_emb = nn.Embedding(regime_vocabs[1], 4)
        self.reg_combo_emb = nn.Embedding(regime_vocabs[2], 8)

        total_emb = 128 + 256 + 256 + 256 + 12 * 8 + 4 + 4 + 8
        self.fc_final = nn.Linear(total_emb, 256)
        self.bn_final = nn.BatchNorm1d(256)
        self.out = nn.Linear(256, 1)

    def _gru_pool(self, gru, emb, x):
        out, _ = gru(emb(x))
        return torch.cat([out.mean(dim=1), out.max(dim=1).values], dim=1)

    def forward(self, x_num, char_ids, bigram_ids, count_seq, count_cols, regs):
        x = self.bn_in(x_num)
        x = F.relu(self.fc_num(x))
        x = self.bn_num(x)
        x = F.dropout(x, self.dropout, training=self.training)
        x = F.relu(self.fc_num2(x))
        x = F.dropout(x, self.dropout, training=self.training)

        char_out = self._gru_pool(self.char_gru, self.char_emb, char_ids)
        bigram_out = self._gru_pool(self.bigram_gru, self.bigram_emb, bigram_ids)
        count_seq_out = self._gru_pool(
            self.count_seq_gru, self.count_seq_emb, count_seq
        )

        count_col_emb = torch.cat(
            [emb(count_cols[:, i]) for i, emb in enumerate(self.count_col_embs)], dim=1
        )
        reg_emb = torch.cat(
            [
                self.reg29_emb(regs[:, 0]),
                self.reg30_emb(regs[:, 1]),
                self.reg_combo_emb(regs[:, 2]),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        z = torch.cat(
            [x, char_out, bigram_out, count_seq_out, count_col_emb, reg_emb], dim=1
        )
        z = self.bn_final(self.fc_final(z))
        z = F.relu(z)
        z = F.dropout(z, self.dropout, training=self.training)
        return self.out(z).squeeze(1)


def predict_model(
    model, X_num, char, bigram, count_seq, count_col, reg, device, batch_size=4096
):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i in range(0, len(X_num), batch_size):
            xb = torch.from_numpy(X_num[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            cb = torch.from_numpy(char[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            bb = torch.from_numpy(bigram[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            cs = torch.from_numpy(count_seq[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            cc = torch.from_numpy(count_col[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)
            rg = torch.from_numpy(reg[i : i + batch_size]).to(device)

            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(xb, cb, bb, cs, cc, rg)
            else:
                logits = model(xb, cb, bb, cs, cc, rg)

            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(preds)


def train_fold(
    X_num_tr,
    X_num_va,
    X_num_te,
    char_tr,
    char_va,
    char_te,
    bigram_tr,
    bigram_va,
    bigram_te,
    count_seq_tr,
    count_seq_va,
    count_seq_te,
    count_col_tr,
    count_col_va,
    count_col_te,
    reg_tr,
    reg_va,
    reg_te,
    y_tr,
    y_va,
    num_numeric,
    seed,
):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_num_tr = scaler.fit_transform(X_num_tr).astype(np.float32)
    X_num_va = scaler.transform(X_num_va).astype(np.float32)
    X_num_te = scaler.transform(X_num_te).astype(np.float32)

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(X_num_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(char_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(bigram_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(count_seq_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(count_col_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(reg_tr),
        torch.from_numpy(y_tr),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        drop_last=True,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=torch.cuda.is_available(),
    )

    model = TabularNN(
        num_numeric=num_numeric,
        char_vocab=V,
        bigram_vocab=V * V,
        count_vocab=int(counts.max()) + 1,
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-5)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS)
    if use_amp:
        scaler_amp = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()

    best_auc = -1.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for xb, cb, bb, cs, cc, rg, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(device)
            cb = cb.to(device)
            bb = bb.to(device)
            cs = cs.to(device)
            cc = cc.to(device)
            rg = rg.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(xb, cb, bb, cs, cc, rg)
                    loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)
                scaler_amp.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler_amp.step(optimizer)
                scaler_amp.update()
            else:
                logits = model(xb, cb, bb, cs, cc, rg)
                loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        val_pred = predict_model(
            model,
            X_num_va,
            char_va,
            bigram_va,
            count_seq_va,
            count_col_va,
            reg_va,
            device,
        )
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, val_pred)
        print(f"    epoch {epoch + 1}: AUC={auc:.6f}", flush=True)

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            patience = 0
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= PATIENCE:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    val_pred = predict_model(
        model,
        X_num_va,
        char_va,
        bigram_va,
        count_seq_va,
        count_col_va,
        reg_va,
        device,
    )
    test_pred = predict_model(
        model,
        X_num_te,
        char_te,
        bigram_te,
        count_seq_te,
        count_col_te,
        reg_te,
        device,
    )
    return val_pred, test_pred, best_auc

import gc
import time
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch

from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)
torch.manual_seed(42)
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print("Device:", device, flush=True)

N_FOLDS = 5
MAX_EPOCHS = 2

A_COLS = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7)]
B_COLS = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(19, 27)]
INT_COLS = [f"f_{i:02d}" for i in range(7, 19)]


def encode_chars(series):
    arr = series.astype(str).values
    bytes_arr = np.array([s.encode("utf-8") for s in arr], dtype="S10")
    codes = np.frombuffer(bytes_arr.tobytes(), dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1, 10).copy()
    codes = codes.astype(np.int16)
    codes = np.where((codes >= 65) & (codes <= 90), codes - 65, 26).astype(np.int32)
    return codes


def build_base_numeric(df):
    parts = []

    A = df[A_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)
    B = df[B_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)

    parts.append(A)
    parts.append(B)

    for arr in (A, B):
        parts.append(arr.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        parts.append(arr.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        parts.append(arr.std(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        parts.append(arr.min(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        parts.append(arr.max(axis=1, keepdims=True))
        parts.append(np.sqrt(np.square(arr).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)))

    for i in range(len(A_COLS)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(A_COLS)):
            parts.append((A[:, i] * A[:, j])[:, None])
            parts.append((A[:, i] - A[:, j])[:, None])

    for i in range(len(B_COLS)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(B_COLS)):
            parts.append((B[:, i] * B[:, j])[:, None])
            parts.append((B[:, i] - B[:, j])[:, None])

    for i in range(7):
        parts.append((A[:, i] * B[:, i])[:, None])
        parts.append((A[:, i] - B[:, i])[:, None])

    f28 = df["f_28"].values.astype(np.float32)
    parts.append(f28[:, None])
    parts.append(np.abs(f28)[:, None])
    parts.append(np.sign(f28)[:, None])
    parts.append((np.sign(f28) * np.sqrt(np.abs(f28)))[:, None])

    int_arr = df[INT_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)
    parts.append(int_arr)
    parts.append(int_arr.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    parts.append(int_arr.std(axis=1, keepdims=True))

    reg = df[["f_29", "f_30"]].values.astype(np.float32)
    parts.append(reg)
    parts.append((reg[:, 0:1] == 1).astype(np.float32))
    parts.append((reg[:, 1:2] == 0).astype(np.float32))
    parts.append((reg[:, 1:2] == 1).astype(np.float32))
    parts.append((reg[:, 1:2] == 2).astype(np.float32))

    return np.hstack(parts).astype(np.float32)


def build_cat_mat(df, chars, full_codes):
    c = chars.astype(np.int64)

    bigrams = (c[:, :-1] * 27 + c[:, 1:]).astype(np.int32)
    trigrams = (c[:, :-2] * 729 + c[:, 1:-1] * 27 + c[:, 2:]).astype(np.int32)
    fourgrams = (
        c[:, :-3] * 19683 + c[:, 1:-2] * 729 + c[:, 2:-1] * 27 + c[:, 3:]
    ).astype(np.int32)

    cnts = df[INT_COLS].values.astype(np.int32)
    reg = df[["f_29", "f_30"]].values.astype(np.int32)
    reg_combo = (reg[:, 0:1] * 3 + reg[:, 1:2]).astype(np.int32)

    return np.column_stack(
        [full_codes, chars, bigrams, trigrams, fourgrams, cnts, reg, reg_combo]
    )


def target_encode_fold(cat_tr, y_tr, cat_va, cat_te, smoothing=20.0):
    prior = float(y_tr.mean())
    tr_list, va_list, te_list = [], [], []

    for col in range(cat_tr.shape[1]):
        vtr = cat_tr[:, col].astype(np.int64)
        vva = cat_va[:, col].astype(np.int64)
        vte = cat_te[:, col].astype(np.int64)

        max_cat = int(max(vtr.max(), vva.max(), vte.max())) + 1
        sums = np.bincount(vtr, weights=y_tr.astype(np.float64), minlength=max_cat)
        cnts = np.bincount(vtr, minlength=max_cat).astype(np.float64)

        enc_tr = (sums[vtr] - y_tr.astype(np.float64) + prior * smoothing) / (
            cnts[vtr] - 1.0 + smoothing
        )
        enc_va = (sums[vva] + prior * smoothing) / (cnts[vva] + smoothing)
        enc_te = (sums[vte] + prior * smoothing) / (cnts[vte] + smoothing)

        tr_list.append(enc_tr[:, None])
        va_list.append(enc_va[:, None])
        te_list.append(enc_te[:, None])

    return (
        np.hstack(tr_list).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack(va_list).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack(te_list).astype(np.float32),
    )


class MoESequenceModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_numeric, num_experts=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()

        self.char_emb = nn.Embedding(27, 48, padding_idx=26)
        self.count_emb = nn.Embedding(17, 32)

        self.char_pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 10, 48))
        self.count_pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 12, 32))
        nn.init.normal_(self.char_pos, std=0.02)
        nn.init.normal_(self.count_pos, std=0.02)

        char_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=48, nhead=4, dim_feedforward=96, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.char_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(char_layer, num_layers=1)

        count_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=32, nhead=4, dim_feedforward=64, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.count_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(count_layer, num_layers=1)

        self.num_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(num_numeric),
            nn.Linear(num_numeric, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )

        seq_dim = 48 * 2 + 32 * 2
        # Regime tensor contains exactly 2 columns: f_29, f_30
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(seq_dim + 128 + 2, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )

        self.experts = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Sequential(
                    nn.Linear(192, 64),
                    nn.ReLU(),
                    nn.Dropout(dropout),
                    nn.Linear(64, 1),
                )
                for _ in range(num_experts)
            ]
        )

        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192 + 2, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, num_experts),
        )

    def forward(self, x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_regime):
        char = self.char_emb(x_char) + self.char_pos
        char = self.char_encoder(char)
        char = torch.cat([char.mean(dim=1), char.max(dim=1).values], dim=1)

        cnt = self.count_emb(x_cnt) + self.count_pos
        cnt = self.count_encoder(cnt)
        cnt = torch.cat([cnt.mean(dim=1), cnt.max(dim=1).values], dim=1)

        num = self.num_mlp(x_num)
        combined = torch.cat([char, cnt, num, x_regime], dim=1)
        rep = self.head(combined)

        gate_in = torch.cat([rep, x_regime], dim=1)
        gate = torch.softmax(self.gate(gate_in), dim=-1)
        expert_out = torch.stack(
            [expert(rep).squeeze(-1) for expert in self.experts], dim=-1
        )
        logits = (gate * expert_out).sum(dim=-1)
        return logits


def predict_proba(model, X_num, X_char, X_cnt, X_reg, bs=PRED_BATCH_SIZE):
    model.eval()
    outs = []
    use_amp = device.type == "cuda"

    with torch.inference_mode():
        for i in range(0, len(X_num), bs):
            x_num = torch.from_numpy(X_num[i : i + bs]).float().to(device)
            x_char = torch.from_numpy(X_char[i : i + bs]).long().to(device)
            x_cnt = torch.from_numpy(X_cnt[i : i + bs]).long().to(device)
            x_regime = torch.from_numpy(X_reg[i : i + bs]).float().to(device)

            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_regime)
            else:
                logits = model(x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_regime)

            outs.append(torch.sigmoid(logits.float()).cpu().numpy())

    return np.concatenate(outs)


def train_fold(
    X_tr,
    char_tr,
    cnt_tr,
    reg_tr,
    y_tr,
    X_va,
    char_va,
    cnt_va,
    reg_va,
    y_va,
    max_epochs=MAX_EPOCHS,
    rank_k=RANK_K,
):
    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.from_numpy(X_tr).float(),
        torch.from_numpy(char_tr).long(),
        torch.from_numpy(cnt_tr).long(),
        torch.from_numpy(reg_tr).float(),
        torch.from_numpy(y_tr).float(),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        drop_last=False,
        num_workers=0,
        pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda"),
    )

    model = MoESequenceModel(X_tr.shape[1]).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=max_epochs, eta_min=1e-5
    )

    use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler() if use_amp else None

    best_auc = -1.0
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        t0 = time.time()

        for batch in loader:
            x_num = batch[0].to(device, non_blocking=True)
            x_char = batch[1].to(device, non_blocking=True)
            x_cnt = batch[2].to(device, non_blocking=True)
            x_regime = batch[3].to(device, non_blocking=True)
            yb = batch[4].to(device, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            if use_amp:
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    logits = model(x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_regime)
                    loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)

                    pos = (yb > 0.5).nonzero(as_tuple=False).view(-1)
                    neg = (yb < 0.5).nonzero(as_tuple=False).view(-1)
                    if pos.numel() > 0 and neg.numel() > 0:
                        k = min(rank_k, pos.numel(), neg.numel())
                        pos = pos[torch.randperm(pos.numel(), device=yb.device)[:k]]
                        neg = neg[torch.randperm(neg.numel(), device=yb.device)[:k]]
                        diff = logits[pos].unsqueeze(1) - logits[neg].unsqueeze(0)
                        rank_loss = -F.logsigmoid(diff).mean()
                        loss = loss + 0.3 * rank_loss

                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                logits = model(x_num, x_char, x_cnt, x_regime)
                loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, yb)

                pos = (yb > 0.5).nonzero(as_tuple=False).view(-1)
                neg = (yb < 0.5).nonzero(as_tuple=False).view(-1)
                if pos.numel() > 0 and neg.numel() > 0:
                    k = min(rank_k, pos.numel(), neg.numel())
                    pos = pos[torch.randperm(pos.numel(), device=yb.device)[:k]]
                    neg = neg[torch.randperm(neg.numel(), device=yb.device)[:k]]
                    diff = logits[pos].unsqueeze(1) - logits[neg].unsqueeze(0)
                    rank_loss = -F.logsigmoid(diff).mean()
                    loss = loss + 0.3 * rank_loss

                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()

        va_pred = predict_proba(model, X_va, char_va, cnt_va, reg_va)
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, va_pred)
        print(
            f"  epoch {epoch + 1}: val AUC {auc:.6f} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)",
            flush=True,
        )

        if auc > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            patience = 0
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 2:
                break

    if best_state is None:
        best_state = {
            k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
        }

    return best_state, best_auc
